title: Q3 Revenue Growth
text: The company reported Q3 revenue growth of 14.2% year-over-year, driven primarily by an increase in net interest income and a 9% rise in fee-based advisory services. Operating margin improved to 31.4% from 28.7% in the prior quarter.
